data.title: Architecture Best Practice: Meta Context Engineering (MCE) via Agentic Skill Evolution — Bi-Level Optimization, Agentic Crossover, and Programmatic Context Artifacts
data.description: Comprehensive OKF specification for Meta Context Engineering (MCE, Ye et al., Peking University 2026): bi-level (1+1)-ES optimization co-evolving learnable Agent Skills (SKILL.md + methodology scripts) via Agentic Crossover at the meta-level and programmatic context files (context/*.md + retrieve_context.py) at the base-level across Finance, Chemistry, Medicine, Law, and AI Safety.
